I’ve been using the MyGP app for a long time and honestly, it’s one of the best telecom apps in Bangladesh. The interface is clean, fast, and very easy to use. Checking data balance, buying internet packs, recharging, and managing offers—all can be done in just a few taps. What I really like is how smooth and stable the app is. It rarely crashes, and everything works exactly as expected. The personalized offers, usage history, and notifications are also very helpful.
